entries.title: Reliever Riley Martin becomes the latest Cubs pitcher to head to the injured list
entries.summary: <p>LOS ANGELES—Eleven o’clock on a Sunday morning, and Cubs catcher Carson Kelly’s attention was drawn to the small group of reporters clustered around Cubs PR man John Steinmiller in a clubhouse doorway, scribbling notes as he spoke.</p><p></p><p>“What’s going on?’’’ he asked. “Everybody good?’’</p><p></p><p>“Roster moves,’’ Steinmiller replied, then recited his list for Kelly’s benefit: Reliever Riley Martin, to the 15-day injured list with left elbow inflammation; reliever Vince Velasquez, designated for assignment; relievers Charlie Barnes and Yacksel Rios added from Iowa.</p><p></p><p>Kelly’s eyes widened during Steinmiller’s recitation.</p><p></p><p>“Good with that?’’ someone asked.</p><p></p><p>“No,’’ Kelly said with exaggerated dismay. “Where’s our pitching coach? Gotta go talk to him.’’</p><p></p><p>Welcome to another spin of the Cubs’ Wheel of Pitching Misfortune, a seemingly daily occurrence in which another Cubs pitcher is hurt and President of Baseball Operations Jed Hoyer is forced to scramble for reinforcements.</p><p></p><p>Martin becomes the 11th pitcher since the start of spring training to go on the injured list, the seventh since the regular season began.</p><p></p><p>Just in the last 10 days, Hoyer has made a staggering 19 roster moves. Velasquez’s DFA was to make room on the 40-man roster for Rios.</p><p></p><p>In the meantime, manager Craig Counsell has been forced to hold together the Cubs’ bullpen with baling wire, Scotch tape and paper clips. Friday night against the Dodgers, he was down to three healthy and rested relievers.</p><p></p><p>Sunday, Counsell used Hoby Milner, who gave up an opposite-field home run to Shohei Ohtani in the seventh for the Dodgers’ final run in their 6-0 win, and Rios, who hasn’t pitched in the big leagues since 2023 but recorded the game’s final five outs.</p><p></p><p>Frustrating?</p><p></p><p>“Yeah, I mean, the next guy’s got to do his job,’’ Counsell said. “That’s kind of where we’re at with this. We’ve got guys coming back soon, so that’s a good thing. But again, the injuries…they have an effect, eventually.’’</p><p></p><p>Counsell said Phil Maton, who has been out since April 6 with knee tendinitis, will be activated during the San Diego series that begins Monday, without specifying a day. Closer Daniel Palencia, out since April 14 with an oblique strain, is scheduled to throw a bullpen Tuesday that should give the staff “a pretty clear idea” how he is progressing, “I think Palencia is going in a good direction,’’ he said.</p><p></p><p>How soon might he be back? “That would be soonish,’’ the manager said. “Is that a word?”</p><p></p><p>Whether Merriam-Webster approves or not, Counsell applied the same word when asked for a timetable on Ethan Roberts, who is working his way back from a cut finger. He said the left-hander wants to throw one more time to make sure the cut is fully healed.</p><p></p><p>And Hunter Harvey (triceps inflammation) will soon be accelerating his recovery to throwing a bullpen.</p><p></p><p></p><p><b>Cora, Cora, Cora</b></p><p></p><p>Third baseman Alex Bregman, who has been close to Alex Cora since their days together in Houston, Bregman as a player and Cora as coach, chose to keep his thoughts to himself when asked about Cora’s firing Saturday night as manager of the Red Sox, where Bregman played last season.</p><p></p><p>Cora’s firing sent shock waves around baseball. “I’m disappointed,’’ Counsell said. “He’s a very good manager, very good at what he does.’’</p><p></p><p>Dodgers manager Dave Roberts also weighed in. “I just don’t know enough,’’ he said. “I just know that’s a very good baseball man, and clearly didn’t have a good relationship [with chief baseball officer Craig Breslow]. It’s unfortunate that it didn’t work out because he was such a big part of Red Sox history.</p><p><b>Shaw, seconded</b></p><p>Swiss Army knife Matt Shaw played second base for the first time in the big leagues, with Nico Hoerner moving to short and Dansby Swanson serving as DH. Counsell said he was looking to give Swanson “half a game off” after the Cubs threw 193 pitches Saturday, a season high for a nine inning game. Shaw handled his only three chances cleanly.</p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><table class="cf wS" role="presentation" style="border-collapse: collapse;" id="rte-976cd830-41cd-11f1-8b94-d932c62878a6"><tbody><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1" class="amq" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 16px; vertical-align: top; width: 44px; visibility: hidden;"></td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1" class="amr" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; width: 811.333px;"><br></td></tr></tbody></table><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p>

entries.title: Cubs drop finale in measuring-stick series against the Dodgers
entries.summary: <p>LOS ANGELES—Two questions hovered over Dodger Stadium in the coolness of an early-spring late afternoon as the buses carrying the Cubs’ traveling party pointed south toward San Diego.</p><p></p><p>The first was this, inspired by the multitude of fans still snaking around the field after the game: How will the home team’s infield survive the pounding feet of the estimated 13,000 kids who ran the bases after the game Sunday afternoon?</p><p></p><p>Somewhere in the bowels of the stadium, it was possible to imagine the head groundskeeper, weeping bitter tears.</p><p></p><p>The second will require some time before the answer is fully revealed: Will the Cubs be back here to play meaningful games in October after the “Back-to-Back World Series Champion Los Angeles Dodgers”—it’s almost a requirement here to refer to them by that handle—recovered from a startling comeback loss Friday night to soundly beat the Cubs in both weekend matinees, 12-4 on Saturday and 6-0 on Sunday.</p><p></p><p>We should have a better idea by early August, when the Dodgers jet to Chicago for three games in Wrigley Field, the only other regular season rendezvous scheduled. But while this late-April exercise gave fans an excuse to contemplate autumn possibilities, the teams parted company knowing nothing certain other than it would do well for them to keep an eye on each other.</p><p></p><p>“The Dodgers have a fantastic team,’’ said Cubs pitcher Shota Imanaga, who never recovered from a three-run yield in the first inning generated by a couple of walks, a throwing error by catcher Carson Kelly, a sacrifice fly, and back-to-back doubles by Kyle Tucker and Miguel Rojas.</p><p></p><p>“But I think when you look at the Cubs,’’ Imanaga continued, “look at all my teammates, we have fantastic players. And I want to be part of that, and be a fantastic player with the Cubs. And hopefully, we can make it out here.’’</p><p></p><p>Neither Imanaga nor the Cubs approached their fantastic best Sunday. Imanaga was touched up for a couple more runs in the sixth, and the Cubs, despite putting the leadoff man on base in each of the first eight innings, could not crack the scoreboard against starter Justin Wrobleski and three relievers.</p><p></p><p>Wrobleski ran his record to 4-0 despite walking four and giving up four hits in six innings. He dodged a bases-loaded, one-out jam by striking out Nico Hoerner, with the help of an ABS reversal of a 3-and-1 pitch to a strike, and inducing Alex Bregman to tap of short.</p><p></p><p>The Cubs could not take advantage of the absence of Mookie Betts, who is out with a strained oblique and did not play this weekend, and catcher Will Smith, who had back stiffness and missed the last two games.</p><p></p><p>They did, however, manage to allay some early-season angst about Shohei Ohtani and Tucker.</p><p></p><p>Ohtani avoided going hitless in four straight games for the first time as a Dodger when he singled in his first at-bat Saturday, ending an 0 for 12 skid. He walked in his next two at-bats, scoring both times, and Sunday was on base all four times he came to the plate, walking, singling and—in the seventh inning—hitting a solo home run off Cubs reliever Hoby Milner. That ended a streak of 59 plate appearances without a home run, an eternity for Shohei watchers.</p><p></p><p>Then there is Tucker, who was supposed to be a difference-maker in Chicago last season, hurt a hammy and wasn’t the same player when he returned. Tucker’s lasting impact on Cubs annals will warrant just a mention, if that.</p><p></p><p>The Dodgers gave him a four-year, $240 million deal to leave, but his desultory play early on here has raised eyebrows, California Post reporter Jack Harris calling him “the most glaring issue in the Dodger lineup.’’ Manager Dave Roberts dropped him from the No. 2 hole to fourth, and Sunday he batted fifth against Imanaga.</p><p></p><p>Now that will be a riveting October storyline should it come to pass: Whose off-season move will generate the greatest payoff, the Dodgers signing Tucker or the Cubs signing Bregman.</p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><table class="cf wS" role="presentation" style="border-collapse: collapse;" id="rte-9813a910-41d9-11f1-9fc1-4fabb81defc0"><tbody><tr><td colspan="1" rowspan="1" class="amq" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px 16px; vertical-align: top; width: 44px; visibility: hidden;"></td><td colspan="1" rowspan="1" class="amr" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; width: 750.667px;"><br></td></tr></tbody></table><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p>

entries.title: Tracking the Bears' undrafted free agent signings
entries.summary: <p>When the NFL Draft ended Saturday night, the <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/bears" target="_blank" >Bears</a> set about negotiating undrafted free agent contracts and sending out tryout invitations for the team’s rookie minicamp at Halas Hall in two weeks.</p><p>The <a class="Link" href="https://chicago.suntimes.com/bears/2026/04/24/first-rounder-dillon-needs-to-be-a-thrillin-fill-in-thieneman" target="_blank" >Bears</a> have had some recent success in that department, landing backup quarterback Tyson Bagent as an undrafted free agent three years ago. Receiver Jahdae Walker was an undrafted free agent last year who caught six passes, including a touchdown against the Packers in December. Cornerback and special teams stalwart Josh Blackwell was an undrafted free agent signed by the Eagles who the Bears claimed in 2022.</p><p>Here’s a look at the Bears’ undrafted free agent moves, per sources:</p><p>• Louisville quarterback <b>Miller Moss</b>, who once backed up Caleb Williams when the two were at USC, is signing with the Bears. Moss threw for 2,679 yards and 16 yards last year after spending his first four seasons with the Trojans.</p><p>• Tulane cornerback <b>KC Eziomume</b>, who played in 11 games last year. He previously played at Albany and Alabama A&M. </p><p>• Wyoming guard <b>Caden Barnett</b>, who was a second-team all-Mountain West guard last year, is signing with the Bears as an undrafted free agent.</p><p>• Utah center <b>Jaren Kump, </b>who played in 59 games in a whopping six years with the Utes. He's played center, guard and tackle.</p><p>• San Diego State kicker <b>Gabriel Plascencia</b>, who went 19-for-23 last year.</p><p>• Kennesaw State running back <b>Coleman Bennett</b>, who had 157 carries for 764 yards and 27 catches for 314 yards last year.</p><p>• Iowa tight end <b>Hayden Large</b>, who had eight catches for 52 yards last year.</p><p>• Wake Forest defensive tackle <b>Jayden Loving, </b>who had 44 tackles and three fumble recoveries last year.</p><p>• Oregon State safety <b>Skyler Thomas</b>, who led the Beavers with 78 tackles last year.</p><p>• Florida State receiver <b>Squirrel White, </b>who had only five catches for 52 yards in 10 games last year after spending three years at Tennessee.</p><p>• Illinois center <b>Josh Kreutz, </b>the son of former Bears center Olin Kreutz, accepted a rookie minicamp invite.</p><p>• James Madison offensive tackle <b>Pat McMurtrie</b> accepted a rookie minicamp invite.</p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p></p><bsp-list-loadmore entries.summary: <h2>Moon Alert</h2> <p>Caution! Avoid shopping (except for food and gas) and important decisions all day after 6 a.m. The moon is in Virgo.</p><h2>Aries (March 21-April 19)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> With your ruler Mars in your sign, you have lots of energy! Plus, you're chatty because Mercury (the planet of communications) is also in Aries. However, today in particular, you might have to lend your efforts to help someone else. (Hey — what goes around, comes around.)</p><h2>Taurus (April 20-May 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> You love good wine, good food, good sex and a nice place to live — and today you might come close to fulfilling your dreams. This is a strong day for you because the moon is in your fellow Earth sign. Enjoy socializing with others. Sports and fun activities with kids will please.</p><h2>Gemini (May 21-June 20)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today is the perfect day to relax at home and play things low-key. You might be involved with a female family member more than usual. Your ability to be charming and diplomatic will be timely. Take note that this is a good week to buy wardrobe items for yourself.</p><h2>Cancer (June 21-July 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Enjoy time with a friend, as well as interacting with groups and organizations today. What you do now might make a difference because your ambition is strong and you’re prepared to speak up for what you want.</p><h2>Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> With the sun at the top of your chart now, you look wonderful to others. In fact, they see you as super competent and capable. Meanwhile, today you're thinking about your values and what really matters. The Dalai Lama said, "The purpose of life is to be happy."</p><h2>Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Today the moon is in your sign, which makes you a tad more emotional than usual. However, it will also slightly increase your good luck over all the other signs. Oh yes. You might even test this by asking the universe for a favor. Why not?</p><h2>Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Be patient with others because fiery Mars is opposite your sign, which can make you feel irritated with others. (They’re probably annoying.) Fortunately, you are the epitome of diplomacy, which is getting what you want while everyone keeps smiling.</p><h2>Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Remember that you need more sleep this week. Don't be down on yourself if you sleep late. Fortunately, both Mercury and Mars are spurring you to work and accomplish what you want. Today is a good day to share your hopes and dreams for the future with someone to get their feedback. Try it.</p><h2>Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Once again, people notice you more than usual, and yes, some will know personal details about your private life. Fortunately, relations with those who are close to you are cozy and supportive. Look for ways to feel happy!</p><h2>Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-7b0000" name="html-embed-module-7b0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>A <b>positive</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Do something different today. As this week begins, you're eager for a bit of adventure and stimulation. Travel or a chance to see new places and meet new faces will please you. (You might do this in your own neighborhood, your own city, or from afar.)</p><h2>Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)</h2> <p></p> <div class="Enhancement" data-align-center> <div class="HtmlModule"><a class="AnchorLink" id="html-embed-module-4d0000" name="html-embed-module-4d0000"></a><div class="HoroscopeStarbox HoroscopeStarbox_five"> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_container"> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> <svg class="HoroscopeStar"><use xlink:href="#icon-star"></use></svg> </div> <div class="HoroscopeStarbox_description"> <p>An <b>average</b> day</p> </div> </div> <style> .HoroscopeStarbox { background: #f8f8f8; display: flex; align-items: center; } .HoroscopeStarbox_container { display: grid; grid-gap: 5px; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; padding: 20px; width: 40%; min-width: 160px; max-width: 200px; } .HoroscopeStarbox_description { padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-1); font-size: var(--body-2); } .HoroscopeStarbox_container svg { object-fit: cover; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; width: 100%; } </style> </div> </div><p> Home and family are your focus right now. You're keen to socialize, and romance is encouraging. Short trips and chances to learn new things and talk to new people will inspire you.
